scenes.heading: Git
scenes.caption: Git is a tool that remembers every saved version of your project. A commit is one saved snapshot with a message about why it exists. It is how teams work on the same code without overwriting each other, and how you undo a change that looked fine yesterday.

scenes.caption: Change a few files that belong to one idea. Stage those files. Commit with a message that says why. Push when you want the copy on the server to include that snapshot.

scenes.heading: Flexbox
scenes.caption: Flexbox lays out a row or a column of items and distributes free space among them. The container is the flex parent. The children are flex items. It is the tool for nav bars, toolbars, and any line of items that should space themselves out.

items: Flexbox lays out a row or a column of items and distributes free space among them

scenes.heading: Step by step: Flexbox
scenes.caption: Set display: flex on the parent. Choose a direction: row or column. Use justify-content for the main direction and align-items for the cross direction. Let items grow or shrink only when you mean them to.

items: Set display: flex on the parent.
Choose a direction: row or column.

scenes.heading: Responsive design
scenes.caption: Responsive design means the same page adapts to the width it is given. A phone and a laptop do not get two unrelated sites. They get one layout that rearranges. Start from the narrow screen. Add rules for wider screens. The narrow layout is the base, not an afterthought.
